{{Top|leg}}
'''Shimmerglass''' was a luxurious type of [[Glass/Legends|glass]]. The exit archway of the [[Tralla Room]] aboard the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'' [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]] was crafted in ornate shimmerglass.<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

While searching for the supplier of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis']] [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' Fleet]] [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaughts]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] spotted infamous starship thief [[Niles Ferrier]] smoking his signature [[carababba tabac]] with [[armudu spice]] [[Cigarra/Legends|cigarra]] beneath the Tralla Room's shimmerglass archway.<ref name="DFR" />
